Maya (CS): Quick weekly health check for Silverpine — focusing on p95/p99 by route & model, streaming vs non-streaming.
Alex_Silverpine (Customer): Thanks! We saw a couple of user reports about slow responses yesterday around 10:30 PT.
Maya (CS): Pulling telemetry now, will paste the highlights.
Samir (SRE): Raw numbers (this week vs last week):
- /chat/streaming (redwood-3-large-q4_2): p95 = 210ms (▲10ms), p99 = 640ms (▲120ms)
- /chat/sync (redwood-3-large-q4_2): p95 = 280ms (▲45ms), p99 = 1200ms (▲450ms)
- /embed (embed-lite-v2): p95 = 85ms (stable), p99 = 160ms (stable)
Elena (PM): Noted that sync p99 increased more than streaming — interesting inverted expectation.
Samir (SRE): Quick hypothesis: sync requests hit long-tail token generation + cold KV cache misses more often. I pulled a trace sample.
Samir (SRE): ```
trace_id: 0xabc123
model: redwood-3-large-q4_2
route: /chat/sync
start_ts: 2026-03-16T17:28:42Z
seq_len: 2048
kv_cache_hits: 0
kv_cache_misses: 12
gpu_util: 31%
latency_ms: 1234
```
Maya (CS): Alex — does your client split prompts or occasionally send full large prompts via sync?
Alex_Silverpine (Customer): We do a mixed approach — streaming used for interactive typing, but some scheduled batch jobs call sync with the whole conversation.
Elena (PM): That aligns — batch/scheduled sync jobs could be responsible for the tail. Are those on a cadence that correlates with the p99 spikes?
Samir (SRE): Yes — we matched timestamps to a Silverpine cron: heavy sync workload at ~10:25-10:35 PT. That matches the user reports.
Maya (CS): Actionable recommendations:
1) Move heavy-batch paths to streaming-only or chunked-sync to enable KV prewarm and lower tail.
2) Add a KV cache warmup for known active sessions (we can add SDK helper).
3) Temporarily raise concurrency for sync route during batch window or schedule batches off-peak.
4) Add alert for sync p99 > 900ms to catch regressions before reports.
Samir (SRE): I'll open an internal ops ticket and add a canary to route streaming-only traffic for a subset of sessions.
ops-bot: Ticket created: OPS-4321 — "Silverpine sync tail mitigation" — assignee: Samir — due: 2026-03-19
Alex_Silverpine (Customer): We'll flip a feature flag to route scheduled jobs to streaming next Monday (2026-03-23) for a small beta group.
Elena (PM): Cost note: shifting to streaming moved tokens slightly (due to chunk overhead) but reduced p99 by ~40% in our internal sim; current spend impact estimated +6% but latency improvement significant.
Maya (CS): Renewal risk status: currently low, but we mark "monitoring" until enablement finishes and p99 stabilizes for two weeks.
Samir (SRE): I'll produce a side-by-side dashboard widget: p95/p99 by route + model + streaming flag, and add error-rate overlay.
Maya (CS): Please also add a small customer-facing note template for Alex to explain the planned change to their PMs.
Alex_Silverpine (Customer): Will do. I'll post the internal RFC and tag you all.
Elena (PM): Next check-in: same time next week. Add "error-rate by route + model" and "cost delta" to the agenda.
Maya (CS): Thanks everyone — saving these notes to our account folder and will mark follow-ups.
Alex_Silverpine (Customer): Thanks team :thumbsup:
